explication: NetExec is a command-line network execution and reconnaissance tool. A user invokes the CLI with targets, credentials, protocol choices, and optional modules; the application selects protocol implementations and modules to interact with remote services, then presents findings and retains protocol-specific state. The tree documents broad protocol and module coverage, but the sampled excerpts do not show the main dispatch flow, so uncertain call wiring is omitted. Database components are shown as persistence responsibilities rather than a detailed storage pipeline.
